## History

Violetta was a dream girl originating from Anne's imagination. As [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) grew up and acquired a real friend, she found that her dream girls were no longer satisfying and ceased having Violetta.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014)_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--violetta.md)

Violetta is an imaginary friend created by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who invented her based on the echo returned by the valley. Their connection exists entirely within Anne's imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)_

- Friend of — imaginary friend invented by Anne from an echo in the valley  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P43](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P58](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0058)</sub>
